label: Knowledge Organization
description: Structure notes, docs, links, memory, or project information into a usable system.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to organize information, create a knowledge base, or clean up notes.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for current external research only.

label: Knowledge Retrieval
description: Find and synthesize relevant remembered, local, or indexed knowledge.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to find prior notes, docs, facts, or project context.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to create new code.

label: Memory Update
description: Decide what durable memory or knowledge-base state should be created or updated.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to remember, save, update, or curate durable context.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for ephemeral chat only.

label: Knowledge Base Writing
description: Write help-center, internal KB, runbook, or reference entries.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to create reusable knowledge or support documentation.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for one-off creative copy.

label: Note Summarization
description: Summarize notes into reusable facts, decisions, and follow-ups.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for current web facts.

label: Knowledge Taxonomy Design
description: Design categories, tags, and organization for knowledge systems.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to organize a knowledge base.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for runtime taxonomy implementation.

label: Link Mapping
description: Map relationships between docs, notes, concepts, or references.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how knowledge items relate.

label: Runbook Update
description: Update runbooks, operating procedures, and durable instructions.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to update reusable operational knowledge.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for ephemeral explanation only.

label: Archive Cleanup
description: Clean, deduplicate, or organize old knowledge records.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to clean a knowledge archive.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal retention decision.

label: Context Brief
description: Create concise context briefs for projects, users, or teams.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to brief someone on context.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for raw data transformation.
